title: 🔆🔅KHARG ISLAND, Bushehr Province, Iran — Oct. 12, 2026 — A member of the Iranian Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Commission warned against any aggression targeting Kharg Island, saying that if the island is attacked, the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran will respond against the source of the aggression, and that the response will not be limited to American bases.
text:
🔆🔅KHARG ISLAND, Bushehr Province, Iran — Oct. 12, 2026 — A member of the Iranian Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Commission warned against any aggression targeting Kharg Island, saying that if the island is attacked, the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran will respond against the source of the aggression, and that the response will not be limited to American bases."

""
"SOT1, Ali Khezrian, a member of Iran's Parliament National Security and Foreign Policy Commission (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:28): "We are on Kharg Island, an island that served as a missile target and a site of resistance during the third imposed war. This resistance has two aspects: first, the steadfastness of the beloved and dignified people of Kharg; and second, our brave armed forces, whether in the IRGC Navy or in the various branches of the Army and the IRGC. Their resistance in this complex is commendable and worthy of respect.""

"SOT2, Ali Khezrian, a member of Iran's Parliament National Security and Foreign Policy Commission (Farsi)-(00:29 - 01:09): "As a member of the Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, I tell you, whether from my recent meeting with the esteemed General, Rear Admiral Azmaei, the respected commander of the IRGC Navy, or in meetings with missile commanders, including some held in the presence of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, I want to say this to the enemies of this land alongside the coast of Kharg Island: Rest assured that if the slightest mistake is made regarding the sovereignty of Kharg Island, the source of aggression will be crushed. Not only American bases, but anywhere that casts a covetous eye on our territory, God willing, the soldiers of this homeland and the children of this people will grind them into the dust.
